title: Blue Mountain Beach "A Peace of Blue" 28 Emerald Beach Circle
h1: Blue Mountain Beach "A Peace of Blue" 28 Emerald Beach Circle
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- 6 Passenger LSV Low speed vehicle- 4 adult bikes- Fire pit- Community pool- Grill- Extended stay available- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Peace of mind and a fabulous time await at A Peace of Blue, where the coastal charm of 30A combines with Blue Mountain Beach’s laid-back environment. This 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home comfortably accommodates 12 guests. Spend sun-drenched days enjoying the white sand beach or reclining beside the community pool, boasting a tropical setting with covered barbecue areas for relaxing in the shade. After a day in the sunshine, guests will love gathering for a nightcap on the cozy porches or roasting s’mores around the firepit.As guests arrive at this 2-story home, a beautiful front porch with a plush loveseat, ambient lighting, and an overhead fan sets the scene for peaceful unwinding day or night. Inside, the great room’s dark wood floors, shiplap wainscoting, and curated artwork create an elegant atmosphere for relaxing. Revel in a fun movie night in the living space, outfitted with a sprawling sectional and 2 armchairs for comfy seating. Delightfully designed, the modern kitchen features a spacious island, open sightlines, and high-end appliances—including an in-wall oven. The dining table, with a long bench and 4 chairs, has plenty of room for group meals, plus extra seating for 4 is available at the breakfast bar. In the morning, slip out the back door with a cup of Joe from the adjacent coffee bar and welcome the day from the second porch’s rocking chair. Steps lead to the private backyard patio, where guests can enjoy grilling in the open air or relaxing on the Adirondack chairs! When night falls, enjoy the gas firepit and string lights beneath the stars before retiring comfortably in the handsome guest bedroom with a soft king bed.Take the stairs to the primary bedroom, which is perfect for families, featuring a king bed, a twin-over-twin bunk bed, and a private bathroom. A guest bedroom with a king bed and a bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds complete the second floor.Get away for charm and tranquility at A Peace of Blue. On-site parking—plus 4 complimentary adult bikes and a premium Denago Ranger XL6 low-speed vehicle, with Bluetooth—makes it easy to explore in style. The nearest beach access is Blue Mountain Beach Regional, less than a mile and a half away! Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed and a Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.

After a day in the sunshine, guests will love gathering for a nightcap on the cozy porches or roasting s’mores around the firepit. As guests arrive at this 2-story home, a beautiful front porch with a plush loveseat, ambient lighting, and an overhead fan sets the scene for peaceful unwinding day or night.
